MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
25003802
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F01170215
WELLS FARGO BANK NA, is the
Plaintiff, and LETANDSON ARISTIL,
ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of
execution for the sale of mortgaged
premises dated 10/31/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 11TH DAY of
FEBRUARY A.D. 2026, at the hour of
one thirty o' clock by the then
prevailing (Standard or Daylight
Saving) time, in the afternoon of
the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel,
10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the TOWNSHIP OF WOODBRIDGE,
County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey.
Premises commonly known as: 242
CHURCH STREET, WOODBRIDGE, NJ 07095-2423
Tax Lot: 222 f/k/a 222 and 223, Tax
Block: 409.05 f/k/a 409.E
Dimensions of Lot: 40 x 100
Nearest Cross Street: E. WASHINGTON AVE.
The occupancy status of the
subject property is unknown.
The approximate upset sum is
$324,449.30 calculated through
November 17, 2025 plus any additional advance, interest, Sheriff's cost and commission to the date of
sale.
The sale is subject to any unpaid
taxes and assessments, tax, water
and sewer liens and other municipal
assessments. The amount due can
be obtained from the local taxing
authority. Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale may also be subject to the limited lien priority of any
condominium/home-owner association liens which may exist. The sale may be further subject to
Restrictions, reversions, reservations, and easements of record.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the upset to be satisfied by said sale is the sum of TWO HUNDRED THIRTEEN THOUSAND SEVENTEEN DOLLARS AND FIFTY FIVE CENTS ($213,017.55) dollers more or less, plus interest together with the costs of this sale. THE UPSETAMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official bank check at
close of sale and the balance in two
weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Logs Legal Group LLP
14000 Commerce Parkway Suite B
Mount Laurel, NJ 08054
Attorneys
